positions.subject: q:housing/citywide-rezoning
positions.summary: Voted yes when the Board of Supervisors passed the Family Zoning Plan zoning map ordinance (File No. 250700) on first reading on December 2, 2025, 7 to 4; he was recorded as excused at final passage on December 9, 2025.

citations.quote: December 02, 2025 Board of Supervisors - PASSED ON FIRST READING Ayes: 7 - Dorsey, Mahmood, Mandelman, Melgar, Sauter, Sherrill and Wong Noes: 4 - Chan, Chen, Fielder and Walton

citations.locator: p. 72, legislative history, December 09, 2025 final passage

positions.subject: q:transportation/local-tax-for-muni
positions.summary: Is listed as a signer of the proponents' argument in favor of Proposition H, the November 2026 measure for a new annual parcel tax to fund Muni service, in the official Voter Information Pamphlet.

citations.quote: The Proposal: Starting July 1, 2027, and continuing until June 30, 2042, Proposition H would fund Muni service through a new annual parcel tax on real estate in San Francisco.
citations.locator: PDF p. 126 (printed p. 124), Proposition H digest, The Proposal

citations.quote: VOTE YES ON H FOR STRONGER MUNI.
citations.locator: PDF p. 128 (printed p. 126), Proponent's Argument in Favor of Proposition H

citations.quote: Supervisors: Rafael Mandelman Connie Chan Steven Sherrill Danny Sauter Alan Wong
citations.locator: PDF p. 128 (printed p. 126), signers of the Proponent's Argument in Favor of Proposition H
